catalog.name: Naruto Kai Ultimate Subbed Edition
catalog.description:
NARUTO KAI: ULTIMATE SUBBED EDITION

A fan project dedicated to removing filler, padding, and executive recaps from the anime.

Structure:
- Season 1: Manga Content (Volumes 1–72)
- Season 2: Post-Series Content (Shinden Novels, The Last Movie, Extras)

Includes re-translated Japanese dub subtitles, restored canonical scenes, Omake extras, The Last: Naruto the Movie, and Itachi Shinden.

Nyaa Torrent: https://nyaa.si/view/1063188

--------------------------------------------------
Note on Complete Canon:
To watch 100% of canonical Naruto prior to Boruto, watch these outside this torrent:
- The Day Naruto Became Hokage (OVA)
- Naruto Shippuden Episodes 484–500 (Blank Period Novels: Sasuke Shinden, Shikamaru Hiden, and Konoha Hiden)

videos.title: Episode 01 - Naruto Uzumaki! (Ch. 1–7)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 1. Naruto steals the Scroll of Sealing, learns Shadow Clones, and forms Team 7 with Sasuke and Sakura under Kakashi.

videos.title: Episode 02 - The Worst Client (Ch. 8–16)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 2. Team 7 takes a C-rank mission to escort bridge-builder Tazuna to the Land of Waves and faces Zabuza Momochi.

videos.title: Episode 03 - For My Dream! (Ch. 17–27)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 3. The climax of the Land of Waves arc; Haku and Zabuza make their final stand on the Great Naruto Bridge.

videos.title: Episode 04 - The Hero's Bridge! (Ch. 28–36)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 4. The Chunin Exams begin in Konoha. Team 7 passes the written portion and enters the Forest of Death.

videos.title: Episode 05 - The Challengers! (Ch. 37–45)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 5. Orochimaru attacks Team 7 in the Forest of Death and brands Sasuke with the Cursed Seal of Heaven.

videos.title: Episode 06 - Predator (Ch. 46–54)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 6. Preliminary rounds of the Chunin Exams commence in the Third Exam arena.

videos.title: Episode 07 - The Right Path! (Ch. 55–63)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 7. The preliminaries continue with intense matchups, including Sakura vs. Ino and Rock Lee vs. Gaara.

videos.title: Episode 08 - Life-or-Death Battles! (Ch. 64–72)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 8. Preliminaries conclude. Jiraiya takes Naruto under his wing to teach him the Summoning Jutsu.

videos.title: Episode 09 - Neji vs Hinata (Ch. 73–81)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 9. Naruto clashes with Neji Hyuga in the main finals of the Chunin Exams.

videos.title: Episode 10 - A Splendid Ninja! (Ch. 82–90)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 10. Sasuke battles Gaara, triggering the surprise invasion of Konoha by Sound and Sand shinobi.

videos.title: Episode 11 - Seeking Apprenticeship! (Ch. 91–99)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 11. Third Hokage Hiruzen Sarutobi fights Orochimaru using the Reaper Death Seal.

videos.title: Episode 12 - The Great Flight! (Ch. 100–108)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 12. Naruto summons Gamabunta to duel Gaara transformed into the One-Tail Shukaku.

videos.title: Episode 13 - The Chunin Exams, Concluded! (Ch. 109–117)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 13. The Konoha Crush arc concludes with the funeral of the Third Hokage.

videos.title: Episode 14 - Hokage vs Hokage! (Ch. 118–126)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 14. Itachi Uchiha and Kisame Hoshigaki arrive in Konoha hunting the Nine-Tails.

videos.title: Episode 15 - Naruto's Ninja Handbook! (Ch. 127–135)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 15. Naruto and Jiraiya search for Tsunade; Jiraiya begins training Naruto in the Rasengan.

videos.title: Episode 16 - Eulogy (Ch. 136–144)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 16. The Legendary Sanin battle: Jiraiya and Tsunade face Orochimaru and Kabuto.

videos.title: Episode 17 - Itachi's Power! (Ch. 145–153)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 17. Tsunade accepts the title of Fifth Hokage and returns to heal Konoha.

videos.title: Episode 18 - Tsunade's Decision! (Ch. 154–162)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 18. Sasuke grows bitter over Naruto's rapid growth and challenges him on the hospital roof.

videos.title: Episode 19 - The Successor (Ch. 163–171)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 19. The Sound Four arrive in Konoha to entice Sasuke to join Orochimaru.

videos.title: Episode 20 - Naruto vs Sasuke! (Ch. 172–180)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 20. The Sasuke Retrieval Squad is formed under newly promoted Chunin Shikamaru Nara.

videos.title: Episode 21 - Pursuit (Ch. 181–189)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 21. Choji fights Jirobo and Neji fights Kidomaru in life-or-death 1v1 battles.

videos.title: Episode 22 - Comrades (Ch. 190–198)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 22. Kiba fights Sakon/Ukon while Shikamaru strategizes against Tayuya.

videos.title: Episode 23 - Predicament (Ch. 199–207)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 23. Rock Lee and the Sand Siblings (Gaara, Kankuro, Temari) reinforce the retrieval team against Kimimaro.

videos.title: Episode 24 - Unorthodox (Ch. 208–217)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 24. Naruto confronts Sasuke at the Valley of the End.

videos.title: Episode 25 - Itachi And Sasuke, Brothers (Ch. 218–228)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 25. Flashback to the Uchiha Clan Massacre and the night Sasuke lost his family.

videos.title: Episode 26 - Awakening (Ch. 229–235)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 26. One-Tailed Naruto vs. Curse Mark Stage 2 Sasuke at the Valley of the End. Part 1 Climax.

videos.title: Episode 27 A - Day of Departure! (Ch. 236–238)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 27 (Part 1). The aftermath of the Valley of the End fight. Naruto leaves Konoha with Jiraiya for 2.5 years of training.

videos.title: Episode 27 B - Kakashi Chronicles (Ch. 239–244)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 27 (Part 2). Kakashi Gaiden: Young Kakashi, Obito Uchiha, and Rin Nohara on their tragic mission at Kannabi Bridge.

videos.title: Episode 28 - Naruto's Homecoming! (Ch. 245–253)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 28. Naruto returns to Konoha. Akatsuki's Deidara and Sasori attack the Sunagakure to capture Kazekage Gaara.

videos.title: Episode 29 - Kakashi vs Itachi! (Ch. 254–262)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 29. Team Kakashi and Team Guy head to the Sand Village to rescue Gaara.

videos.title: Episode 30 - Puppet Masters (Ch. 263–271)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 30. Chiyo and Sakura fight Sasori while Naruto and Kakashi pursue Deidara.

videos.title: Episode 31 - Entrusted Feelings! (Ch. 272–281)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 31. Kazekage Rescue climax; Chiyo uses her life force jutsu to revive Gaara.

videos.title: Episode 32 - The Road to Sasuke! (Ch. 282–290)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 32. Sai and Captain Yamato join Team 7 for a mission to intercept Orochimaru's spy at Tenchi Bridge.

videos.title: Episode 33 - Top-Secret Mission! (Ch. 291–299)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 33. Four-Tailed Naruto goes berserk against Orochimaru at Tenchi Bridge.

videos.title: Episode 34 - The Reunion! (Ch. 300–309)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 34. Team 7 infiltrates Orochimaru's hideout and reunites with Sasuke after 3 years.

videos.title: Episode 35 - The New Duo! (Ch. 310–319)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 35. Naruto begins Wind-style nature transformation training. Akatsuki members Hidan and Kakuzu invade the Land of Fire.

videos.title: Episode 36 - Team 10 (Ch. 320–329)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 36. Team 10 battles Hidan and Kakuzu; Asuma Sarutobi makes the ultimate sacrifice.

videos.title: Episode 37 - Shikamaru's Battle! (Ch. 330–339)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 37. Shikamaru executes his master plan against Hidan while Naruto unveils the Wind Style: Rasenshuriken.

videos.title: Episode 38 - The Fruits of Training! (Ch. 340–349)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 38. Sasuke turns against Orochimaru and forms Team Hebi to hunt Itachi.

videos.title: Episode 39 - On the Move (Ch. 350–359)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 39. Deidara fights Sasuke in an explosive battle of art and Sharingan.

videos.title: Episode 40 - The Ultimate Art! (Ch. 360–369)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 40. Jiraiya infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village to uncover the identity of Akatsuki leader Pain.

videos.title: Episode 41 - Jiraiya's Choice! (Ch. 370–379)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 41. Jiraiya enters Sage Mode against Pain's Six Paths and leaves his final encoded message.

videos.title: Episode 42 - The Secret of the Mangekyo! (Ch. 380–389)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 42. Sasuke vs. Itachi Uchiha; the truth behind the Mangekyo Sharingan is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 43 - The One Who Knows the Truth (Ch. 390–399)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 43. Tobi reveals the dark secret of the Uchiha Massacre to Sasuke, prompting him to form Team Taka.

videos.title: Episode 44 - Inheriting Sage Jutsu! (Ch. 400–408)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 44. Naruto travels to Mount Myoboku to learn Toad Sage Mode while Sasuke attacks Killer Bee.

videos.title: Episode 45 - Leaf Battlefield (Ch. 409–417)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 45. Pain invades Konoha, devastating the village in search of the Nine-Tails.

videos.title: Episode 46 - Naruto Returns! (Ch. 418–427)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 46. Sage Mode Naruto arrives to defend Konoha against Pain.

videos.title: Episode 47 - The Broken Seal! (Ch. 428–437)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 47. Hinata defends Naruto; Naruto loses control and enters Eight-Tails form.

videos.title: Episode 48 - The Cheering Village! (Ch. 438–447)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 48. Naruto meets Minato Namikaze inside his inner mind and confronts Nagato.

videos.title: Episode 49 - The Five Kage Summit Commences! (Ch. 448–457)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 49. The Five Kage assemble in the Land of Iron; Danzo Shimura acts as interim Sixth Hokage.

videos.title: Episode 50 - Water Prison Death Match (Ch. 458–467)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 50. Sasuke crashes the Five Kage Summit; Tobi declares the Fourth Shinobi World War.

videos.title: Episode 51 - Sasuke vs Danzo! (Ch. 468–477)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 51. Sasuke battles Danzo Shimura and exacts vengeance for Itachi.

videos.title: Episode 52 - Team 7, Together Again! (Ch. 478–487)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 52. Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi confront Sasuke before he receives Itachi's eyes.

videos.title: Episode 53 - Naruto's Birth (Ch. 488–497)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 53. Naruto travels to the Falls of Truth on Turtle Island to master the Nine-Tails with Killer Bee.

videos.title: Episode 54 - Bridge To Peace (Ch. 498–507)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 54. Naruto meets Kushina Uzumaki and unlocks Nine-Tails Chakra Mode. Kisame fights Guy.

videos.title: Episode 55 - The Great War Begins (Ch. 508–516)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 55. Konan fights Tobi in the Hidden Rain. The Allied Shinobi Forces mobilize for war.

videos.title: Episode 56 - Team Asuma's Reunion! (Ch. 517–525)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 58. Reanimated shinobi take the battlefield; Team 10 faces their former master Asuma.

videos.title: Episode 57 - Naruto Heads to the Battlefield! (Ch. 526–534)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 57. Naruto breaks through the barrier to join the war effort.

videos.title: Episode 58 - Naruto vs Itachi! (Ch. 535–544)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 58. Reanimated Itachi and Nagato fight Naruto and Bee; Itachi breaks Kabuto's control with Shisui's eye.

videos.title: Episode 59 - The Five Kage, Assembled! (Ch. 545–554)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 59. The real Madara Uchiha is reanimated on the battlefield against the Five Kage.

videos.title: Episode 60 - Kurama! (Ch. 555–564)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 60. Naruto connects with Kurama and unlocks Tailed Beast Mode to fight the reanimated Jinchuriki.

videos.title: Episode 61 - Brothers, United! (Ch. 565–574)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 61. Itachi and Sasuke team up to battle Kabuto and release the Reanimation Jutsu.

videos.title: Episode 62 - The Crack (Ch. 575–584)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 62. Naruto, Bee, Kakashi, and Guy unmask Tobi, revealing Obito Uchiha.

videos.title: Episode 63 - World of Dreams (Ch. 585–594)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 63. The Ten-Tails is revived on the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 64 - Ten Tails (Ch. 595–607)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 64. Neji Hyuga sacrifices his life to protect Naruto and Hinata.

videos.title: Episode 65 - Hashirama and Madara (Ch. 608–617)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 65. Orochimaru reanimates the Four Hokage so Sasuke can learn the true history of Konoha.

videos.title: Episode 66 - A New Three-Way Deadlock! (Ch. 618–627)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 66. The Hokage join the war; Team 7 reunites on the front lines.

videos.title: Episode 67 - Breakthrough (Ch. 628–637)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 67. Obito becomes the Ten-Tails Jinchuriki.

videos.title: Episode 68 - Naruto's Path (Ch. 638–647)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 68. The Shinobi Alliance pulls the Tailed Beasts out of Obito.

videos.title: Episode 69 - The Start of a Crimson Spring (Ch. 648–657)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 69. Madara fully revives; Might Guy opens the Eighth Gate of Death.

videos.title: Episode 70 - Naruto and the Sage of Six Paths (Ch. 658–667)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 70. Hagoromo Otsutsuki bestows Six Paths powers upon Naruto and Sasuke.

videos.title: Episode 71 - I Love You (Ch. 668–679)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 71. Kaguya Otsutsuki emerges as the final threat.

videos.title: Episode 72 - Naruto Uzumaki! (Ch. 680–700)
videos.overview: Adapts Volume 72. Team 7 seals Kaguya; Naruto and Sasuke settle their fate at the Valley of the End. Epilogue included.

videos.title: Shinden 1 - Itachi Shinden Part 1: Bright Light
videos.overview: Light novel adaptation of Itachi Uchiha's childhood, entrance into ANBU, and relationship with Shisui.

videos.title: Shinden 2 - Itachi Shinden Part 2: Dark Night
videos.overview: Light novel adaptation detailing the tragic events leading directly to the Uchiha Clan Massacre.

videos.title: Movie - The Last: Naruto the Movie (2014)
videos.overview: Canonical post-war film set 2 years after Chapter 699. Naruto and Team 7 travel to the moon to stop Toneri Otsutsuki.

videos.title: Extra - Kakashi Sensei's Real Face! (Omake)
videos.overview: Special comedy short where Team 7 attempts to unmask Kakashi Hatake.

videos.title: Extra - Scroll of Wind: The True Face (Special)
videos.overview: Official manga side-story adaptation celebrating the Naruto exhibition.
